title: Remove misleading unused non-Bash pipe-protection observations in the shell word scanner
outcome: The scanner documents the protections actually consumed by qualification and does not imply unused dialect flags establish containment.
acceptance: Remove unused non-Bash containment observation branches or supply meaningful consumers/tests for them, preserving existing word/offset decoder behavior.
Document that wrappers and Unknown runtime never qualify, while only the known-Bash qualification caller consumes containment flags.
Focused decoder/recognition controls and independent review cover the change.
